note: Every external thing this build needs, where it comes from, and how to tell it is the right bytes. `sha256` is empty where the source is a git checkout rather than an archive; `pinned` says whether a fixed commit is recorded.

toolchain.note: Installed on the machine, not fetched by the repository. doctor.ps1 checks the version, not a hash.

clang-cl.note: MSVC-compatible driver; /O2 /W3 and the MSVC CRT come from the VS Build Tools install

dotnet.note: only needed to build the shader harness; prebuilt binaries make it a developer-only requirement

python.note: the tools under tools/ are stdlib-only; uv can supply it

rustc.note: only for xwin, if that route is taken for the Windows SDK

sources.name: ryubing
sources.used_by: tools/shaders/scripts/setup_ryujinx.ps1 (downloads it when there is no local checkout)

sources.name: nxrecomp
sources.risk: a commit id is not a guarantee: this upstream has already had e7a5a54 reported unreachable. Vendor a tarball here once a working copy is confirmed.

sources.name: astc-encoder
sources.risk: cloned at whatever the default branch is that day: the ASTC transcode output can change between builds

sources.name: ispc
sources.note: the script already computes and prints its SHA256; paste it here once confirmed

generated_artifacts.name: shader patches
generated_artifacts.note: The cache holds hand-built modules for a handful of shaders (fog, uv, the stencil-plane samplers, the light list). A clean build has none of them, so its picture is NOT the maintainer's picture. tools/shader/patch_ds_samplers.py regenerates one family from the player's own cache; the rest are still manual.
generated_artifacts.action: keep this list in step with xc2/game/shader-patch/, and make each one reproducible from the player's cache

generated_artifacts.name: spirv.preload.pack
generated_artifacts.note: built from the cache by tools/shader-cache/pack.py; the runtime reads it BEFORE the loose .spv files, so a stale pack hides a freshly installed shader
